posts.cooked:
X-Celerate’s surname is misspelled “Marson.”

Bruce quickly does these summaries during the game and they really don’t undergo editing, so little omissions and misspellings are par for the course. We’re just grateful he does them at all.

Kudos for making the first Australian Superteam (as far as I know).

During the first session’s character creation I put it up to the players as to where the game would be set. Australia won out 3-2. Now I just have to do enough research to throw in a few Australian things to give the game a bit of that flavor. I do not attempt accents though, as that would be terrible.

Nice background, especially that mysterious “Old Man.”
Making (almost) all the Heroes part of the same family/company is a nifty idea.

Thanks! I find the more specific the frame for the campaign is, the easier it is to get everyone on the same page. So it’s not just a superhero game, it’s a superhero game about running a family business that fights giant monsters.

I don’t know why, but for some reason Spite and Baron Blade being in Australia just seems funny to me.

While doing character creation, I encouraged the players to throw some references to existing SotM villains. I mean, Baron Blade is definitely a multinational villain. Spite in Australia seems a little weirder, but there’s no specific reason he couldn’t turn up there. I’m not sticking super-closely to established SotM canon anyway.

It seems like the Group Table at the top of the write-up is missing Nightwalker.

Nightwalker is actually an NPC. For these sessions he was a d10 lieutenant, but I do have a full hero write-up for him that I may use at some point.

It’s fun to see one of @FrivYeti’s Environments being used in actual play!

Yeah, I love those environments, and if you continue to follow our sessions you’ll probably see more of them pop up.

…I’m sorry, keys?
Oh, that’s what the keys are for. c.c Yowza.

That part is entirely the player’s idea. He loves the idea he is using teleportation and speed to leave his keys inside the bad guys. The idea of a key donation barrel was also entirely his thing, but I thought it was way too funny.

…I’m sorry, Onyxia? XD Did Ambuscade get any DKP off that wipe?

So of course what I actually said was everyone had seen Ansel G. Moreau on TV taking out Nixious the Chosen with a flamethrower and shielding Mainstay from Borr the Unstable with his own body. Our scribe, Bruce, has never played the Sentinels card game and has only a peripheral knowledge of the characters from that game, so he just wrote what he thought he heard.

Not enough people use the phrase “in high dudgeon” enough these days.

Bruce has that kind of vocabulary!

I’m guessing Nightstalker had a great deal of admiration for Ansel G. Moreau before finding out they had become rivals.

Possibly. The players haven’t dug into Walker’s motivations yet.

Wow! Okay, that was a session and a half! If nothing else, I am enjoying the strange and varied ways you’re shunting canon characters into this otherwise original setting.

I definitely have plans for a few of the Sentinels villains! My thought is that most things that happened before Oblivaeon are canon for this setting, but things after Oblivaeon are my own to play with. Clearly I sent Ansel G. Moreau on a completely different path than the canon version of the character.

fjur:

“Terrible” as in you’re bad at accents or “terrible” as in it would be in poor taste?

Both, I guess. If I could do a good accent it wouldn’t be offensive, but to do a bad one reflects badly on everyone.

fjur:

Dynamo Joe is a great supername

Tim had just read The Murderbot Diaries and was really struggling with coming up with a name other than “Murderbot.” But he got there in the end!

fjur:

I wonder whatever happened to Conteh Energy’s owner, and why is there a picture of a completely-random crocodile at Conteh Energy?

Mysteries abound… I don’t know if any of my players know the metafiction enough to have made that connection.

fjur:

Why is there a picture of Dr. Broussard in a bikini?

I claim no responsibility for that. Ernest found those pictures on the internet and insisted that’s what Dr. Broussard looks like. Honestly, in my mind I was picturing a more solidly built woman. But I always view world-building as a consensual activity, so I let it ride. I’m pretty sure Ernest snuck in after Bruce completed the session summary and pasted those images in there.

fjur:

Wait a minute, is it possible that Nightstalker chose his hero-name in emulation of Ambuscade’s Night Hunter persona?

Well, Ambuscade never became Night Hunter in my setting, he took a different path. The name Nightwalker is one I came up with after considering many variations of names with ‘Night’ or ‘Dark’ or ‘Shadow’ in them. It’s tough because there are already so many characters in comic fiction with names like that. I expected ‘streetwalker’ jokes and of course it was one of the first things the players said.

Y’know, now that I think about it, Nightstalker kinda reminds a bit of @mistergone’s NPC Starshadow in his Alternates game which he posts recaps of on here.

I read @mistergone 's recaps and enjoy them, but there wasn’t any intentional connection.
